# Workspace components

The `zola` binary in `src/` is a thin CLI over the crates below. A crate may
only depend on crates in a lower layer; the layer number is the longest
dependency path to a leaf, computed from the manifests.

| Layer | Component | Responsibility |
| ----- | --------- | -------------- |
| 0 | `console` | Terminal output: notices, warnings, errors, build summaries. Printing only — no logic. |
| 0 | `errors` | Thin re-export of anyhow (`Result`, `bail!`, `Context`) so every crate reports errors the same way. |
| 1 | `utils` | Leaf helpers shared by everything: filesystem access via fs-err, globs, slugs, anchors, TOC, deserialization, build timings. |
| 2 | `config` | Parses zola.toml/config.toml and theme.toml, owns markdown/search/link-checker/taxonomy settings and the highlighting setup. |
| 3 | `content` | The in-memory site: Page, Section, Taxonomy and the Library index (permalinks, translations, backlinks, colocated assets). |
| 3 | `imageproc` | Image resizing and format conversion plus the on-disk cache of processed images. |
| 3 | `link_checker` | External link validation with caching; internal-link checking lives in site. |
| 4 | `render` | Rendering layer: the Renderer that calls Tera, pagination, and RenderCache, which pre-serializes the library once per build. |
| 4 | `search` | Search index generation (elasticlunr and fuse output formats). |
| 5 | `markdown` | Markdown to HTML: pulldown-cmark, heading anchors, TOC, summaries, syntax highlighting, internal-link resolution. |
| 6 | `templates` | The Tera instance, built-in templates, and every custom function and filter exposed to templates. |
| 7 | `site` | Orchestration: loads content, renders markdown, builds the render cache, turns every artifact into a Job and writes it out. |

## Tests and benchmarks

Unit tests live next to the code in every crate; the table lists the
integration-test and benchmark targets, which is what you run to exercise a
component end to end.

| Component | Integration tests | Benchmarks |
| --------- | ----------------- | ---------- |
| `imageproc` | `cargo test -p imageproc --test resize_image` | — |
| `markdown` | `cargo test -p markdown --test img`, `cargo test -p markdown --test links`, `cargo test -p markdown --test markdown`, `cargo test -p markdown --test summary`, `cargo test -p markdown --test toc` | `all.rs` |
| `site` | `cargo test -p site --test invalid`, `cargo test -p site --test site`, `cargo test -p site --test site_i18n` | `load.rs` |

## Performance-sensitive components

Open `PERF-*` items are derived from `docs/performance/HOTSPOTS.md`.

| Component | Why it matters | Open PERF items |
| --------- | -------------- | --------------- |
| `utils` | Owns the output-directory clean and the static-tree copy, both serial today. | PERF-004, PERF-007 |
| `config` | Highlighting registry initialisation is fixed startup cost paid before any page is read. | PERF-011 |
| `content` | Library construction and page parsing are on the critical path of every build. | — |
| `render` | RenderCache::build is a dominant CPU and memory phase on large sites. | PERF-008 |
| `markdown` | Syntax highlighting dominates this crate's cost on sites with code blocks. | — |
| `templates` | load_data and get_* functions run once per page; registration clones site state. | PERF-009 |
| `site` | Owns discovery, the output queue, output-directory cleaning and the static copy. | PERF-003 |
